
  CASE #1099: The Unreachable Host
  Target api.example.com:443   Investigator its-always-dns 1.0.0

  Suspect 1: The Resolver
    system lookup         api.example.com does not exist (NXDOMAIN or no records)  22 ms
    1.1.1.1               NXDOMAIN: this resolver says the name does not exist  8 ms
    Verdict: Guilty. Obviously.

  Suspect 2: The Network
    skipped               not questioned: DNS gave us no address to call
    Verdict: Not questioned.

  ────────────────────────────────────────────
  It was DNS.

  Evidence:
    - system lookup: api.example.com does not exist (NXDOMAIN or no records)
    - 1.1.1.1: NXDOMAIN: this resolver says the name does not exist
  Exit code 53. Use --serious for a boring report.
